config_first_1200:
# JCC Core control-plane configuration (P1)
# Secrets are NEVER stored here — only env-var NAMES. See config/.env.example.

server:
  host: 127.0.0.1          # localhost-only; run.py also forces 127.0.0.1 at bind
  port: 4778
  cors_origins:            # EXPLICIT allowlist only — never "*"
    - http://localhost:5173
    - http://127.0.0.1:5173
    - http://localhost:3000
    - http://127.0.0.1:3000

control:
  token_env: JCC_CONTROL_TOKEN   # read at runtime; unset => control locked (401)

state_store:
  db_path: F:/jev/runtime/jcc/jcc.db   # gitignored runtime dir; WAL enabled

jev:
  provider: mock            # mock | disabled | real
  model: jev-1.13.0
  api_key_env: JEV_API_KEY
  base_url: https://api.typesafe.ai
  feature_flags:
    real_provider: false    # real provider stays OFF until explicitly enabled + key present

actuation:
  enabled: false            # P0-P2: actuation OFF (ADR-0004). Refuses ALL side-effects.
  allowed_actions: []       # none permitted in P1

policy:
  version: p3.0.0           # ADR-0008 D-37: p1.0.0 -> p3.0.0 (R6 threshold surface)
  priority: [ESCALATE, PAUSE, VERIFY, STEER, RETRY, FINISH, CONTINUE]
  thresholds:               # ADR-0008 D-24:
